subscriptions.err_bill_void.en: This subscription is void, so it bills nothing. Unvoid it in Documents to bill it again.

subscriptions.err_bill_not_active.en: Only an active subscription bills, and this one is not active. Revert it to draft in Documents, then activate it on its page.

subscriptions.err_agreement_activate.en: A draft subscription starts only with Activate on its own page, which sets its first bill date. Documents can void it, but not finalize or issue it.

subscriptions.err_agreement_status_lifec.en: A subscription is only ever draft, active, paused, cancelled or void. Change its status on its own page: activate, pause, resume or cancel it there. Documents can void it, unvoid it or revert it to draft.
